title: Passage 13
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Bob likes climbing.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃喜欢攀岩。

sentences.en: But he was sad that there wasn't a climbing club in his school at first.
sentences.cn: 但一开始学校里没有攀岩社团，这让他很伤心。

sentences.en: At the beginning of the second year of middle school,
sentences.cn: 在初中二年级开始的时候，

sentences.en: his school offered rock climbing lessons in order to encourage students to exercise.
sentences.cn: 他的学校为了鼓励学生锻炼身体，开设了攀岩课。

sentences.en: He joined at once.
sentences.cn: 他立刻加入了。

sentences.en: He had planned to wear a jacket, a pair of jeans and a T-shirt.
sentences.cn: 他原本打算穿一件夹克、一条牛仔裤和一件T恤。

sentences.en: But before the first class, he was notified to wear hiking boots and prepare warm clothing, such as a sweater.
sentences.cn: 但在第一节课前，他被通知说要穿登山鞋，并预备保暖的衣物，比如毛衣。

sentences.en: In class, the coach said, "Rock climbing needs strength, speed, courage and persistence."
sentences.cn: 教练在课上说：“攀岩需要力量、速度、勇气和坚持。”

sentences.en: It interested him.
sentences.cn: 这让他感兴趣。

sentences.en: The students were asked to run 1,000 metres first, and then climb with a rope.
sentences.cn: 学生们被要求先跑1000米，然后再用绳子攀爬。

sentences.en: When Bob finished running, he almost lost his breath and got bored.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃跑完后，几乎喘不过气来，而且开始厌烦了。

sentences.en: He thought it was less interesting than before.
sentences.cn: 他觉得攀岩没有以前有趣了。

sentences.en: The coach noticed that and asked him, "Why do you want to take rock climbing lessons?"
sentences.cn: 教练注意到了这一点，于是问他：“你为什么想来参加攀岩课？”

sentences.en: "I come for fun, sir."
sentences.cn: “老师，我是为了好玩。”

sentences.en: "Is that fun?" he asked.
sentences.cn: “那好玩吗？”他问。

sentences.en: Bob shook his head slowly.
sentences.cn: 鲍勃慢慢地摇了摇头。

sentences.en: The coach then explained patiently, "That's because you stop halfway. You know, beautiful sights are always on the top."
sentences.cn: 接着，教练耐心地解释说：“那是因为你停在了半路。要知道，美丽的风景总是在顶峰。”

sentences.en: After hearing his words, Bob made up his mind to finish his journey.
sentences.cn: 听了他的话后，鲍勃下定决心要走完这趟旅程。

sentences.en: When he got to the top in the end, he felt really excited.
sentences.cn: 当他最终到达山顶时，他感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Although feeling sore in his muscles, he was determined to keep going.
sentences.cn: 尽管感觉肌肉酸痛，但他决定继续坚持下去。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's hard to reach the top of the mountain, especially on windy days,
sentences.cn: 有时候，登上山顶很难，尤其是在刮风的日子里，

sentences.en: but it's a pity to stop halfway, so don't give up.
sentences.cn: 但半途而废太可惜了，所以不要放弃。
